headline: The new booking campaign restarted the ads: ₹5,432 spent, 7 bookings at ₹776 each (2–8 Nov), after no spend the week before.

tips.title: Cost per booking above target
tips.text: Each booking cost ₹776, above the ₹500 target and the ₹325 of 08Sep26. It is the campaign's first week, so judge it gently.

tips.title: Frequency is high
tips.text: People saw the ads 2.98 times on average (reach 6,563). Above 2.5 in week one is a warning sign of the audience tiring.

tips.title: Strong lead flow
tips.text: The campaign brought 27 leads at ₹201 each, and 234 link clicks at a 1.20% click rate.

tips.title: Slow start
tips.text: Spend was ₹0 on Monday 2 Nov and only ₹157 on Tuesday, so 6 of 7 days ran. The campaign was created on 3 Nov, which explains it.

actions: Leave the campaign unchanged for another 7 days so it can finish learning, then compare cost per booking against this week's ₹776.
Watch frequency (2.98 now); if it stays above 2.5, add a fresh video or widen the audience.
Check why 27 leads became only 7 bookings, and speed up follow-up on new leads.
